title: Pure Malicevorous
summary: Dark Mist's Malicevorous Rank 2 Xyz swarm build, pairing Malicevorous Spoon, Fork, and Knife with the Sacred Beast Level 2 DARK Fiend engine, Tour Guide From the Underworld, and Rank-Up-Magic Barian's Force.

summary.title: Starters
points: Malicevorous Knife revives another Malicevorous monster from the GY when Normal Summoned, while Malicevorous Fork sends a Fiend from your hand to the GY to Special Summon itself.
Dark Beckoning Beast searches Opening of the Spirit Gates or Chaos Summoning Beast on Normal Summon and grants an extra Normal Summon of a 0 ATK / 0 DEF Fiend.
Tour Guide From the Underworld summons Fiendish Rhino Warrior from the Deck to link into Muckraker From the Underworld and dump Malicevorous Spoon, Fork, or Knife to the GY.

summary.title: Opening: Fork + Knife + Spoon into Number 96
steps: Send a Level 2 Fiend or Malicevorous Spoon from your hand to the GY to Special Summon Malicevorous Fork.
Normal Summon Malicevorous Knife to revive Malicevorous Spoon from the GY.
When another Level 2 Fiend is summoned, Malicevorous Spoon revives a third Level 2 Fiend from your GY.
Overlay three Level 2 DARK Fiends into Number 96: Dark Mist, or two into Gigantic Spright or Number 65: Djinn Buster.

summary.title: Spirit Gates & Level 2 Fiend Recursion
summary.text: Dark Beckoning Beast and Chaos Summoning Beast are both Level 2 DARK Fiends with 0 ATK and 0 DEF. Opening of the Spirit Gates discards a Malicevorous from your hand to revive a 0/0 Fiend every turn, which in turn triggers Malicevorous Spoon on the field to revive another Level 2 Fiend and assemble 3-material Rank 2 Xyz monsters.

summary.title: Bosses & Rank-Up Payoffs
points: Number 96: Dark Mist detaches a material during battle to halve an opposing monster's ATK and gain that lost ATK.
Number 65: Djinn Buster detaches 2 materials as a Quick Effect to negate an opponent's monster effect and inflict 500 damage.
Rank-Up-Magic Barian's Force upgrades Number 96 into Rank 3 Number C96: Dark Storm, or upgrades Djinn Buster into Number C65: King Overfiend to lock out opposing on-field monster effects.
Gigantic Spright detaches a material to summon any Level 2 Malicevorous from the Deck, while Spright Sprind dumps a Level 2 on summon and bounces a monster by detaching an Xyz material.

allow.Tour Guide From the Underworld: Normal Summon starter that summons Fiendish Rhino Warrior to search your Malicevorous pieces or send a Malicevorous directly from the Deck to the GY.
allow.Fiendish Rhino Warrior: Sends Malicevorous Spoon, Fork, or Knife from your Deck to the GY when sent to the GY, ensuring Malicevorous Knife and Spoon always have revival targets.
allow.Dark Beckoning Beast: Level 2 DARK Fiend starter that searches Opening of the Spirit Gates on Normal Summon and grants an extra Normal Summon of a 0/0 Fiend, providing two Level 2 DARK Fiend bodies alongside Opening of the Spirit Gates!
allow.Chaos Summoning Beast: Level 2 DARK Fiend with 0 ATK / 0 DEF searched by Dark Beckoning Beast and Normal Summoned via its extra summon effect—instantly putting 2 Level 2 DARK Fiends on the board to pair with a 3rd Malicevorous for 3-material Number 96: Dark Mist!
allow.Opening of the Spirit Gates: Continuous Spell searched by Dark Beckoning Beast that discards 1 card to revive a 0/0 Fiend every turn!
allow.Rank-Up-Magic Barian's Force: Upgrades Rank 2 Number 96: Dark Mist or Number 65: Djinn Buster into their Rank 3 Chaos forms (Number C96: Dark Storm or Number C65: King Overfiend).
allow.Gigantic Spright: Rank 2 Xyz made with any two Level 2 Malicevorous monsters that detaches 1 material to Special Summon any Level 2 monster directly from your Deck!
allow.Number 65: Djinn Buster: Rank 2 DARK Fiend Xyz (2 Level 2 DARK monsters) that detaches 2 materials as a Quick Effect to negate an opponent's monster effect and inflict 500 burn damage.
allow.Number C65: King Overfiend: Rank 3 DARK Fiend Chaos Xyz stacked over Djinn Buster via Barian's Force that prevents your opponent from activating monster effects on the field while Djinn Buster is attached.
allow.Muckraker From the Underworld: Link-2 DARK Fiend that discards a Malicevorous to revive any Malicevorous or Rank 2 Fiend Xyz from your GY.
allow.Spright Sprind: Link-2 combo engine that foolish burials any Level 2 monster from Deck.

main: Core Level 2 DARK Fiend: when another Level 2 Fiend with a different name is Normal or Special Summoned to your field, targets 1 Level 2 Fiend in your GY and Special Summons it!
Core Level 2 DARK Fiend extender: sends 1 other Fiend monster from your hand to the GY to Special Summon itself from your hand.

Core Level 2 DARK Fiend starter: when Normal Summoned, targets 1 'Malicevorous' monster (except Knife) in your GY and Special Summons it—immediately triggering Malicevorous Spoon if Spoon is on the field or revived!

Level 2 DARK Fiend (0 ATK / 0 DEF): searches Chaos Summoning Beast or Opening of the Spirit Gates on Normal Summon and grants an extra Normal Summon of a 0/0 Fiend, providing instant Level 2 DARK Fiend materials!
Level 2 DARK Fiend (0 ATK / 0 DEF) Normal Summoned alongside Dark Beckoning Beast to trigger Malicevorous Spoon and assemble 3-material Rank 2 Xyz monsters.
Summons Fiendish Rhino Warrior from the Deck to link into Muckraker From the Underworld.
Protects your Malicevorous Fiends on the field and sends Malicevorous Spoon, Fork, or Knife from the Deck to the GY when sent to the GY.
Searched by Dark Beckoning Beast: discards a Malicevorous from hand to revive Dark Beckoning Beast or Chaos Summoning Beast every turn (which triggers Malicevorous Spoon!).
Ranks up Rank 2 Number 96: Dark Mist into Rank 3 Number C96: Dark Storm, or Rank 2 Number 65: Djinn Buster into Rank 3 Number C65: King Overfiend.
extra: Dark Mist's signature Rank 2 DARK Fiend Xyz boss (3 Level 2 monsters—assembled by Fork + Knife + Spoon!): detaches 1 material when battling an opponent's monster to halve that monster's ATK and permanently gain that lost ATK!
Rank 3 DARK Fiend Chaos Xyz boss: cannot be destroyed by battle, forces your opponent to also take any battle damage you take, and drops an opponent's monster's ATK to 0 and gains that original ATK!
Rank 2 DARK Fiend Xyz: detaches 2 materials when an opponent's monster activates its effect to negate the activation and burn for 500.
Rank 3 DARK Fiend Chaos Xyz that locks your opponent out of activating monster effects on the field while Number 65 is attached.
Rank 2 Xyz that detaches 1 material to Special Summon Malicevorous Spoon, Fork, or Knife directly from your Deck.
Link-2 DARK Fiend that discards a card to revive any Malicevorous Fiend from your GY.
Link-2: Quick Effect Link Summons during opponent's Main Phase and gives the summoned monster effect-destruction immunity.
Link-2: sends any Level 2 monster from Deck to GY on summon and bounces an opponent's monster when an Xyz material is detached.
Rank 2: cannot be destroyed by battle with a WATER material, and doubles the original ATK/DEF of a Rank 4 or lower Xyz monster.
